title: SDS Data Statuses
description: SDS Data Statuses is a web page that was written to automate and simplify quality control checks for the SSEC Data Center.
This page provides a hierarchy of content that allows all active problems to be viewed at a glance and more detailed information to be easily accessed with a few clicks.
The back-end API for this page collects stats from dozens of machines and conducts thousands of automated checks.
